newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa launches probe into Indian insulators.
newsitem.headline: South Africa launches probe into Indian insulators.

text.p: South Africa's Board on Tariffs and Trade said on Tuesday it had initiated the country's first ever countervailing case, investigating alleged subsidised exports of porcelain insulators from India.

Legislation designed to protect South African industry from subsidised exports has been on the statute books for some time but the Board said this was the first serious petition requesting countervailing action.
South Africa had consulted with the Indian government before initiating the process, the Board added.
